comments.value:
What should be relatively important regardless of the size, is to allow scaling by default, and make the change for that option for the world creator something possible to change on the website. I have worlds i cannot reupload anymore, but I want people to be able to scale in there. 

The removal of other means of scaling is detrimental if it is disallowed in many places, which to me seems extremely pointless and a really bad decision, that really removes a core feature that avatar creators always use nowadays. if the issue is people scaling too big and being disruptive, then it should simply disallow those extreme sizes unless the world creator allows unlimited scaling options.

Scaling absolutely needs to be enabled by default - and preferably without arbitrarily low limits. By disabling scaling by default, the default is functionally being changed - scaling has been de facto enabled in all worlds already. As such, by defaulting to disabled this breaks existing worlds, when in practice only a small number of worlds enforce scale currently. (I can think of two)

I think hard capping avatar height and breaking everyone's scaling is probably the worst implementation of this idea one could come up with. I understand being uncomfortable with a sudden change per world, but you can't just take away the ability of others to feel comfortable. Plenty of folks have avatars well over 9ft, mine is twice that and I have friends who are even taller. You have to curate your own experience on the internet, it's just a part of life and trying to take away from other's experiences for your own comfort is selfish

My option based on the above, 

Default for all worlds: Let the player chose [Scaling off, Scaling 2-9ft]

For worlds with Scaling Explicitly turned on, have no default scale limits. 

Worlds can then set custom limits and possibly scale the user's avatar on demand. Which could be used for neat effect in game or story worlds.
@{5f2ddfd263aa6f7311d4cb7e|full_name}: Yes! This would be optimal in my opinion.

@{6494fb57bec709090d2ae775|full_name}: Sorry! I meant for people to be able to keep their own avatar height of course. I would never want people to be capped on height, that would be awful. I would only be suggesting this as an additional option people could toggle on, and I hope that VRC people looking at this would realize that. I was looking for a middle ground so that even in worlds where scaling wasn't enabled people could still have access to some scaling, without coming up against the argument of "what if this breaks the world?"

I would of course prefer scaling to be on all the time personally, and definitely on by default in worlds that haven't picked an option (I upvoted that one too).

I think having always-on scaling with much tighter restrictions for worlds that don't have it 'enabled'/customized is a really clever compromise. I think people would be pretty happy with this solution
@{60ddcbb6e920e2339db9698a|full_name}: read the beta announcement please, the change is made on the website already with no reupload

Adding on to this as I've come to understand more about avatar scaling, there really needs to be a way to prevent a world author from scaling you without your consent (perhaps a toggle in the quick menu for "allow world author to scale you" which you could turn off. I would not feel comfortable going to  a world and then having my height changed without my consent by the world author, for the same reasons outlined in the original post. My body is my body and no one should be doing anything to me without my consent.

I understand that some people may not understand this, but to many people in vrchat our avatars are the same as our irl bodies (or even more our bodies than the irl ones). And consent needs to be asked, always. 

If a world really wanted to be able to scale people, they could put like a sign near spawn explaining why to people and ask them to turn the function on. But they should always be asking to do that, not telling me that something will be done to me no matter how i feel.

I would still want to be able to scale myself even if i have disabled the world author's ability to scale me. Otherwise i will not be able to use scaling at all just because i have personal boundaries and care about consent, which goes against the point of having scaling.

details:
In every world, allow scaling between a smaller range of "average" eye heights  - perhaps between 2-9 ft tall. This height range allows players to match the height of the most common avatar scales, and will already have been accounted for by every world creator. Make this always persist between worlds. This is important for users to feel safe and to not be scaled suddenly without their consent.

Common avatar height categories this would cover:

2 ft-4 ft: Kon and small furries

3-5 feet: many japanese avatar styles

4-8 feet: western human avatars

6-9 feet: tall furries

All these sizes are very reasonable to be in and are not disruptive or immersion-breaking in any way. Different social groups have a different average height, which it is important to be close to for normal interaction. This would allow people to use one avatar for different friend groups. If this isn't implemented, I will personally have to upload 5 avatar sizes for every avatar I make, in order to be able to interact with all my friends.

Being forced to change size suddenly on world change is very disruptive, and goes against VRChat's policy of having users be able to choose their own options in order to have an experience where they feel safe and in control.

As an example, I have one avatar uploaded. It has an eye height of 3 feet, because many of my friends are short and I want to be at eye height with them to interact normally. I hang out with that friend group, and then leave to spend time with my other friend. He has an eye height of probably 9 or 10 feet. I want to be similar height with him, so I scale myself to  have an eye height of 8 feet. We go world hopping, and I am having fun. Then we enter a world with scaling turned off. Suddenly I am the size of my friend's foot. I feel upset and maybe a bit scared. Perhaps I was not in a safe brain space to be small, especially suddenly and without my consent. When I log off, I immediately go and upload 5 avatar versions of my avatar, each with a different scale, to avoid having such a bad experience again.

Similarly, if I upload a tall avatar and scale myself down to spend time with small friends, I am in danger on world change of stepping on them or having a social dynamic I do not want.
title: [1311] Always allow scaling between 2-9 feet eye height
